description: The 2026 BMW 430i xDrive Coupe pairs striking Vegas Red Metallic paint with confident all-wheel-drive performance and the responsive feel of a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder. With 255 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque, delivered through an automatic transmission, this used BMW has covered 30,688 miles and is rated at 27 mpg city and 34 mpg highway. Its sleek four-seat cabin brings sporty style and everyday comfort together.Stay connected and comfortable with Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, real-time traffic navigation, satellite radio readiness, and a Wi-Fi hotspot. Heated memory seats, a sunroof, keyless entry, push-button start, and wireless phone charging add convenience, while a backup camera, blind spot monitor, cross-traffic alert, collision warning, and lane keep assist support greater awareness on the road.2026 BMW 4 Series Safety and Security FeaturesAutomatic emergency braking for intersection and junction cross scenarios helps respond to potential hazards. A rear seat reminder, dual front knee airbags, and traffic sign recognition add further protection and awareness. Front and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering, while four-wheel ABS and an anti-theft system with interior motion and anti-tow sensors round out its safety and security features.2026 BMW 4 Series Entertainment and Technology FeaturesA 14.9-inch infotainment screen anchors the cabins technology. BMW ConnectedDrive and Amazon Alexa compatibility support connected features, while a compatible phone can function as a key. Voice-operated hands-free calling and audio controls make interaction easier; the system includes 10 speakers, HD radio, and a touchscreen display.2026 BMW 4 Series Performance FeaturesAuto start/stop helps reduce fuel use when the vehicle is stationary, and a regenerative braking system recovers energy during deceleration.Discounted price requires a preferred payment method (cash, cashiers check without lien instructions, Capital One Auto Navigator pre-approval, or financing through an approved lender).
